evidence: A New Zealand customer recommends RockAuto for Japanese-car parts, citing availability and lower prices even with international shipping.

evidence_sources.author: EdwardDiego
evidence_sources.excerpt: when it comes to getting parts for Japanese cars, I thoroughly recommend rockauto.com, a US colleague put me onto it, and I use it from NZ because a) it has parts I struggle to find in NZ and b) even with the international shipping, parts are cheaper from there than locally.

source_story_title: Jailbreaking my car's navigation system just so I can change the time
